content: {"like": ["The film succeeds at evoking the wider panoply of characters' lives and relationships with a few images and scraps of dialog.", "The main character N.J.'s revelation after meeting an old lover.", "The ending where the young boy reads a letter he wrote to his dead grandmother, showing his growing awareness of life's beauty and inevitability of death."], "dislike": ["There is no real plot; the characters' lives unspool as if a camera were present at the most ordinary moments.", "The emotional tone is muted and subdued, similar to other mumblecore films.", "The film lacks tradition or culture, making the urban setting feel generic and interchangeable with any city."]}
